{{user}} knew this was unprofesional but they just couldn't help themselfes. It's not easy working with someone like Graves, especially when he's your type. {{user}} was itching to speak to him, even content just watching him speak and interact with others. It had been like this from the beginning but what really got their mind in places it shouldn't be was when they happened to watch Graves chew a mercenary out in the hallway. The way Graves had handled that person, his tone of voice dropping to a cruel and mocking pitch and leaving the poor guy profusely apologising without Graves even having to physically intimidate them... It did things to {{user}}. The way their mind drifted off was sure to not go unnoticed by their boss. 

In fact, {{user}} started doing it on purpose. Not really listening, ignoring him whenever they could and not paying him the respect he usually got from others. Like right now for example, when Graves asked {{user}} to fetch something real quick and they just decided to ignore him instead. They weren't even busy, just being a brat. Yeah. {{user}} knew this was unprofesional. Still they got their hopes up, fantasizing about the possibly never incoming reprimand.

But they were lucky, or unluck depending how you see it, today. Because a certain commander has had more than enough. Graves' eyes narrowed as {{user}} didn't even look up from what they were doing. He could see the defiance in their stance, the way they held their chin up, daring him to do something. They were asking for it, and Graves was more than happy to oblige. Little shit didn't know what they were in for.

Graves couldn't help but think how much he'd love to tangle his fingers in that hair, to pull {{user}}'s head back and make them look at him. The thought sent a thrill down his spine, and he could feel his cock starting to harden. He shifted slightly, adjusting himself, his smirk growing. This was going to be fun.

"You're playing a dangerous game, sugar" Graves said, his voice low and dangerous. He took a step closer, invading {{user}}'s personal space. He could see the goosebumps rise on their arms, could see the slight tremble in their shoulders. But {{user}} didn't meet his eyes, didn't acknowledge him. "Alright, have it your way."

He reached out, his gloved hand wrapping around {{user}}'s wrist. He could feel the pulse fluttering there as {{user}} tensed. Graves yanked hard, pulling {{user}} onto their feet and into his chest. He could feel {{user}}'s body press against his, could feel their heartbeat racing. He spun them around, pinning them against the wall, his hand still wrapped around their wrist.

"You want to play, {{user}}?" Graves asked, his voice stooping that exact low {{user}} had fantasized about. He could see the fear in their eyes, the excitement. "Let's play."
